title: Non-retrievable standard for controlled-substance destruction
rule_summary: Controlled substances destroyed by a registrant must be rendered non-retrievable so their physical or chemical condition is permanently altered and unavailable for practical use.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply destruction standard requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing destruction standard with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
